_note: Execution role for the PROD watchdog schedule. EventBridge Scheduler invokes Lambda by ASSUMING this role (unlike classic EventBridge rules, which use Lambda resource-based permissions). deploy.py must create an equivalent role trusting scheduler.amazonaws.com with aws:SourceAccount=<new account id>, and a lambda:InvokeFunction policy scoped to the new pest-model-watchdog function ARN (both bare and :* forms). PARAMETERIZE: account id (in ARN, trust condition, and policy resource), region, function ARN. Role/policy names carry random suffixes -> generate fresh names in deploy.py; do not hardcode d585792c00.
